title: Armor; novitiate; prize
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): XI–XII. Recruits fight both open works belonging toward ye flesh and hidden heart-wickedness. XVII. Ye prize prepared for conquerors stands as ye tree belonging toward life, ye crown belonging toward life, ye new name. — X. Ye Apostle sets out ye armor (Eph. 6)—breastplate belonging toward righteousness, shield belonging toward faith, helmet belonging toward salvation, sword belonging toward ye Spirit.
pass_b_english: X. The Apostle sets out the armor (Eph. 6)—breastplate of righteousness, shield of faith, helmet of salvation, sword of the Spirit.
XI–XII. Recruits fight both open works of the flesh and hidden heart-wickedness. XVII. The prize prepared for conquerors is the tree of life, the crown of life, the new name.
source_text: X. Arma militiae promunt Apostolus Eph. 6:10ff.—lorica iustitiae, scutum fidei, galea salutis, gladius Spiritus. XI–XII. Tirones adversus manifesta opera carnis et occultas cordis improbitates. XVII. Brabeum victoribus paratum est arbor vitae, corona vitae, nomen novum (Rev. 2).
